approval.description: {{host}} shows an approval request for this phone. Enter this six-digit code there and choose Allow; the phone connects on its own. The request expires after 10 minutes.

detail.name: Name
detail.safetyCodeFooter: Matches the code shown for this phone in Settings › Devices on the computer. If it differs, remove this computer and pair again.
detail.scopesFooter: The computer grants these permissions. To change them, open Settings › Devices on the computer.

empty.description: On your computer, open Cocurdex Settings › Devices, create a pairing QR code, and scan it with this phone.
empty.title: No Computers

status.pending: Waiting for approval on the computer
